summary: Second and final round, over plan r3. Three of six seats succeeded (Claude, Codex, GLM), exactly the quorum; Qwen timed out, Gemini and Kimi returned no schema-valid response. All three voted revise and none raised a blocking concern. Claude and GLM found all seven round-one fixes resolved; Codex found five resolved and two incomplete. Three concerns reached agreement: the interim #226 reply has no LR2 home (Claude, Codex, GLM); the example's second verify path and its extraction sidecar are missing from H9 and LR2-C5 (Claude, Codex); D1 (d)'s 'extend' contradicts R0.4 and the LR3 lane omits the corpus tests (Claude, GLM). The driving agent confirmed the conflict path (reading.py:395), the disclosure table (docs/reference/disclosure.md:20) and the corpus tests' existence. Claude and GLM share one CLI codebase, so two of the three successes are weaker evidence of independence.
